questions.question: Is the patch's brightness in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean over pixels of (B02 + B03 + B04) / 3 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's brightness in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean over pixels of (B02 + B03 + B04) / 3 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's greenness (NDVI) in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDVI, (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04) is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's greenness (NDVI) in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDVI, (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04) is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's variation in greenness in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's standard deviation over pixels of NDVI is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's variation in greenness in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's standard deviation over pixels of NDVI is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's vegetated share in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's share of pixels with NDVI above 0.5 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's vegetated share in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's share of pixels with NDVI above 0.5 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's water index (NDWI) in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDWI, (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08) is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's water index (NDWI) in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDWI, (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08) is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's water share in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's share of pixels with NDWI above 0 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's water share in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's share of pixels with NDWI above 0 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's moisture (NDMI) in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDMI, (B8A - B11) / (B8A + B11) is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's moisture (NDMI) in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDMI, (B8A - B11) / (B8A + B11) is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's shortwave infrared 1 brightness in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean of B11 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's shortwave infrared 1 brightness in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean of B11 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's shortwave infrared 2 brightness in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean of B12 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's shortwave infrared 2 brightness in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean of B12 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's near-infrared texture in the top quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's standard deviation over pixels of B08 is above the 75th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the patch's near-infrared texture in the bottom quarter of patches?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's standard deviation over pixels of B08 is below the 25th percentile of a reference set of 497 Sentinel-2 patches.

questions.question: Is the left half greener than the right half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDVI over the left half of the patch exceeds the mean over the right half.

questions.question: Is the top half greener than the bottom half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDVI over the top half of the patch exceeds the mean over the bottom half.

questions.question: Is the left half higher in water index than the right half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDWI over the left half of the patch exceeds the mean over the right half.

questions.question: Is the top half higher in water index than the bottom half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDWI over the top half of the patch exceeds the mean over the bottom half.

questions.question: Is the left half moister than the right half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDMI over the left half of the patch exceeds the mean over the right half.

questions.question: Is the top half moister than the bottom half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean NDMI over the top half of the patch exceeds the mean over the bottom half.

questions.question: Is the left half brighter than the right half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean brightness, (B02 + B03 + B04) / 3, over the left half of the patch exceeds the mean over the right half.

questions.question: Is the top half brighter than the bottom half?
questions.definition: Yes if the mean brightness, (B02 + B03 + B04) / 3, over the top half of the patch exceeds the mean over the bottom half.

questions.question: Is the patch moister than its visible and near-infrared appearance predicts?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean NDMI, (B8A - B11) / (B8A + B11), exceeds the value predicted by a linear regression on the B02, B03, B04 and B08 means, NDVI mean and NDWI mean fitted over a reference pool.

questions.question: Is the patch brighter in shortwave infrared 1 than its visible and near-infrared appearance predicts?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean B11 exceeds the value predicted by a linear regression on the B02, B03, B04 and B08 means, NDVI mean and NDWI mean fitted over a reference pool.

questions.question: Is the patch brighter in shortwave infrared 2 than its visible and near-infrared appearance predicts?
questions.definition: Yes if the patch's mean B12 exceeds the value predicted by a linear regression on the B02, B03, B04 and B08 means, NDVI mean and NDWI mean fitted over a reference pool.
